description: parity-gateway's log events (log-record.v1, parity-contracts CONVENTIONS "Logging"), from the 0.13.0 starter. Every call-scoped record carries the xsid (the interaction id) and tenant_id; records about a desktop carry agent_id and session_id. The common events (service.*, log.dropped, dependency.*) are logging/events.common.v1.json's.

lifecycle.stale_file_removed.description: A healthy or drained file left by an earlier run was removed at the start (attrs.file).

lifecycle.file_failed.description: The healthy or drained file couldn't be written or removed (attrs.file, error.kind); the healthy file is tried again (attrs.retry_ms).

readiness.gate_started.description: The application started; the readiness gate waits for its checks (attrs.checks) before writing the healthy file.

readiness.passed.description: Every readiness check passes again (service.not_ready names the failing ones).

signal.received.description: SIGTERM or SIGINT (attrs.signal): the first drains (cause signal:<name>), a second exits at once (warn, attrs.exit_code).

signal.handlers_missing.description: The signal handlers couldn't be installed: Spring's shutdown hook still drains, the exit codes differ.

drain.completed.description: Every drainable finished in time: the drained file is written (attrs.file, duration_ms).

drain.timed_out.description: The drain didn't finish within the drain timeout (attrs.waiting_for): no drained file, exit 1.

drain.failed.description: Closing the application failed during the drain: exit 1.

dev.sip_passwords_in_use.description: Profile dev: SIP passwords from a file (loopback only, GW-003); never in production.

session.refused.description: A desktop login was refused before a session existed (attrs.reason: token_invalid, token_claims, token_role, tenant_mismatch, busy, tenant_cap, auth_timeout, auth_first, bad_frame; attrs.close_code). tenant_id is the host's when it is one.

session.opened.description: An agent desktop's session attached to routing-engine and got its snapshot (attrs.attach_generation, attrs.reservations).

session.attach_failed.description: routing-engine refused or missed an attach (error.code; attrs.again: a re-attach). A first attach closes the socket with 4013.

session.reattached.description: After a stream reconnect or a new RE leader the session re-attached; RE's snapshot is the truth again.

session.superseded.description: Another session of the same agent (another tab, or RE's Detached) took over; this one closes with 4009.

session.closing.description: The gateway closes the desktop's socket (attrs.close_code, attrs.reason: auth_failed, token_expired, ping_timeout, send_failed, superseded, drain, ...).

session.closed.description: The desktop's socket closed (attrs.close_code); routing-engine was told to detach (attrs.detach_reason) unless another session took over.

session.close_failed.description: Closing a socket failed (it was already gone).

session.detach_failed.description: routing-engine missed a detach (error.code); its grace timer ends the agent's session there.

session.token_renewed.description: The desktop sent a new token for the same tenant and agent.

session.token_refused.description: The desktop's new token was refused (error.code): the socket closes with 4001.

session.socket_error.description: The desktop's socket failed (error.kind); the close follows.

session.task_failed.description: A session's task threw: the session goes on with the next one (error.stack).

sessions.draining.description: Draining: every desktop is told to reconnect within attrs.spread_ms (attrs.sessions).

sessions.drained.description: The sessions are gone; attrs.closed_at_timeout were closed with 1001 near the timeout.

frame.refused.description: A desktop frame was refused (error.code: bad_request, unavailable before the attach, rate_limited; attrs.frame).

frame.ignored.description: A desktop frame of an unknown type was ignored (attrs.reason).

agent.command_executed.description: A desktop command not about a call this session shows (op: set_state, or an answer or wrap-up this session didn't show) was carried out (outcome ok).

agent.command_refused.description: A desktop command not about a call this session shows was refused (outcome refused; attrs.error_code: the contract code, attrs.answered: what the desktop was told).

offer.delivered.description: An offer frame went to the agent's desktop (attrs.offer_id; attrs.source: watch, attach, reattach). Pairs with routing-engine's offer.sent.

offer.revoked.description: The desktop was told an offer it shows is withdrawn (attrs.reason: expired, caller_gone, detached, ...).

offer.revoke_unmatched.description: routing-engine withdrew an offer the desktop doesn't show (an older one); the frame is still sent.

offer.answered.description: The desktop answered an offer (attrs.answer: accept, reject) and routing-engine took it; an accept gives reservation_id.

reservation.received.description: A reservation (the agent's claim on a call) went to the desktop (attrs.origin; attrs.source: watch, attach, reattach).

wrap_up.started.description: The desktop was told the agent's wrap-up began (attrs.ends_at_ms).

wrap_up.ended.description: The agent ended the wrap-up (attrs.disposition_code) and routing-engine took it.

call.state_changed.description: The desktop was shown a call in a new state (from_state none at the first sight; ringing, connected, held, ended, ...). attrs.source: event, command, attach.

call.updated.description: The desktop was shown a call's new view in the same state (hold, mute, consult, recording, parties).

call.view_failed.description: interaction-engine didn't give a call's view (error.code); not_your_call and not_found end the call on the desktop.

call.command_executed.description: A call command from the desktop (op: hold, resume, mute, unmute, hangup, transfer, consult, merge, complete_transfer, cancel_consult, remove_party) was carried out by interaction-engine.

call.command_refused.description: A command about a call the session shows was refused (outcome refused; attrs.error_code, attrs.answered).

interaction_event.routed.description: An interaction.events record went to the sessions showing the call (event_id, owner_epoch, attrs.event_seq, attrs.event_type).

interaction_event.dropped.description: An interaction.events record couldn't be routed (attrs.reason: missing_header, bad_body, header_body_mismatch).

interaction_events.stopped.description: The interaction.events consumer stopped on an error: desktops get call views only from their commands until a restart.

routing.stream_restored.description: The Watch stream to routing-engine is back (leader_epoch; attrs.new_leader): every session re-attaches.

routing.leader_changed.description: A new routing-engine leader (leader_epoch) on a live stream: every session re-attaches.

routing.stream_lost.description: The Watch stream to routing-engine broke; reconnecting after attrs.retry_ms (backoff to 5 s). While it stays down: one record per 30 s, repeat_count for the rest.

routing.stream_silent.description: No message on the Watch stream for 15 s: it is cancelled and reopened.

routing.acks_failed.description: A batch of acknowledgements didn't reach routing-engine (error.code, attrs.acks); it redelivers, sessions drop repeats.

log.external.description: A record of a library the gateway uses (Spring, Tomcat, gRPC, Kafka): attrs.logger names it, its text is msg.
